# GENERATED by tests/sounds/gen_vectors.py scripts (every frame, CRC and reply from the spec's reference
# codec): edit the generator, not this file. gen_vectors.py check fails when the two disagree.
# CYMA-1 Sounds T3 (docs/CYMA-1-sounds-spec.md §5.6 P2-P4, P6; §11.1): our SysEx handler never takes, answers or
# is upset by the platform's frames, and the platform's own USB jobs (backup, restore) still work while our
# frames are being handled. Every platform frame below is declined by app_sysex (sx_taken 0: on the device it goes
# on to fm1-base: ann/log/remote/wifi, then ota_service and usb_cmd), gets no reply and changes nothing (the
# wasm test, tools/sounds_smoke.mjs, checks the same through web_cy_sx's return). Damaged frames of ours get
# a NAK and change nothing; reply-range commands are claimed and never answered (no echo loops).
#   run by tools/run_all.sh (step sounds_scen): gen_vectors.py scen --host build/host/cyma-1_host

# U01 saved from the panel first, so the backup below holds a bank

expect user_writes 1

#
# ==== a flood (the hardening round, spec revision 2026-10-24b): 240 frames back to back, no main-loop pass
# between them, one in ten the platform's. Each platform frame: declined at once (sx_taken 0), no reply from us,
# nothing changes. Each frame of ours: exactly its reply, byte for byte. GET_DIR's CRC is always the bank's as it
# is now (the firmware may cache it: across a USB commit, a panel SAVE, a restore and a reboot it must follow).
# (The USB send ring is the device's, not the simulator's: the reserve app_sx_send keeps for the platform's own
# replies is measured against fm1-base's usb.c, see the spec's revision 2026-10-24b.)
expect sx_crc_stale 0

# ---- the platform restores the backup taken before the flood (U01, U04, U32): GET_DIR's CRC follows the bank
# the restore put back (nothing was open on our side, so nothing of ours is sent)
restore out:sounds_flood_bank.bin
wait 200
expect restore_rc 0
expect user_mask 2147483657
expect user_writes 4
